title: Configurations and eligibility (registry/eligibility.yaml)
description: Which SoC configurations are registered (walked, T0-tested nightly, shown on the dashboard), which are frozen or silicon, and (Phase 4) which default branches the bot may auto-merge into. Changed only through a merge request to the registry's protected main. Owner: registry loader. B2, B5, D2, H1, E3, E5.

auto_merge.description: Phase 4 (E2, E3, E5). Component id -> change classes the bot may auto-merge into that component's default branch, once shadow mode has ended. Absent or empty in v1.

id.description: B2. Also the <config> segment of keep/<config>/<component> tags (C10).

component.description: B2: must be a catalogue component of class soc_ref or example.

ref.description: B2: the branch or tag on the component's canonical host.

commit.description: Required when frozen. B5 and T0 use this commit even if the tag moves; a tag that stops peeling to it raises an alert (C10).

silicon.description: B5, F1, F4, C10 (silicon/<chip>-rNpM). A silicon configuration is always frozen.

upgrade_from.description: D2 upgrade-path clone: the previous release to upgrade from. Absent -> gate t0.clone.upgrade-path records SKIP with the reason.
